name: Iron scroll
description: An iron scroll that was Tamiyo's, guarded by a spider kami in a spirit web.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House

timeline.summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
timeline.quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

timeline.summary: Kaito, with the scroll in hand, tells the Wanderer he will return it to Genku, Tamiyo's widower, by morning.
timeline.quote: Genku will have his lost wife's scroll back in the library come morning.
